title: Malicious code in @lendkzn/baileys (npm)
description: The npm package @lendkzn/baileys contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. This compromise allows an attacker to gain full control, risking exposure of all secrets and keys stored on the affected system. Immediate removal of the package is recommended, but full remediation requires rotating all secrets and keys from a different, uncompromised machine due to potential persistent malicious presence.
